resources.string: Records both sides of WhatsApp and app calls. Set it up once; after a restart it takes one tap.
Call capture isn\'t available on this phone. Voice notes and shared recordings still work.
In the phone\'s Settings, open About phone and tap Build number 7 times.
Free, from Google Play. It lets EchoLedger start its capture helper.
In Shizuku tap Pairing. Then in Developer options › Wireless debugging tap Pair device with pairing code, and type the 6-digit code into Shizuku\'s notification. Once only.
Open Shizuku and tap Start. Android turns Wireless debugging off at every restart, so this is the one tap after a restart. If Shizuku asks to pair, do the pairing step again.
Wireless debugging is off. Turn it on first (Developer options › Wireless debugging), then open Shizuku and tap Start. If Shizuku asks to pair, do the pairing step again.
Start the helper from the computer again
This phone was set up with the computer method. After a restart, run the command from the computer again, or set up Shizuku so it takes one tap on the phone.
Shizuku asks once: choose Allow all the time.
One tap. EchoLedger starts it again by itself whenever Shizuku is running.
Nothing can be recorded until EchoLedger may use the microphone.
EchoLedger can\'t tell you when recording stops working, or ask after a call.
Android or the battery saver ended it. Start it again: one tap.
Allow EchoLedger in Shizuku so it can start the capture helper.
Start it to record both sides of calls.
The helper stopped when the phone restarted
Android turns off Wireless debugging at every restart, which stops Shizuku. Open Shizuku and tap Start: EchoLedger starts the helper by itself.
Call capture isn\'t set up yet
Follow the steps above. It takes about 2 minutes.
The capture helper is from an older version
Start it again so it records with this version\'s fixes.
The capture helper didn\'t get ready
Turn it on to record calls without opening the app.
Allowed to run in the background
Android may stop EchoLedger in the background
Allow it to run in the background so calls are recorded while the app is closed.
EchoLedger can\'t see who you call
Allow notification access so each call is named after the person.
%1$d MB free. A long call may not fit.
Recordings stay on this phone and are transcribed once you sign in.
The last call had both sides
Only your voice was recorded in the last call
Test a call to find out why.
